results.question: Which vehicles have had 5 or more do-not-drive recalls? Give the make, model and model year.
results.answer:
Five vehicles have had 5 or more do-not-drive recalls. Each has exactly 5, and all are BMWs:

- 2002 M3
- 2007 X5
- 2008 X5
- 2009 X5
- 2009 X6

The X5 and X6 models also have many other recall campaigns. The 2009 X5 has 12 in total.
results.sql: select make, model_family as model, model_year, do_not_drive_recalls, recall_campaigns from vehicle_complaint_summary where do_not_drive_recalls >= 5 order by do_not_drive_recalls desc, make, model_family, model_year

results.question: In 2023, which make had the most service brake complaints where the owner reported a crash?
results.answer:
In 2023, FORD had the most service brake complaints reporting a crash. It had 82 crash complaints, out of 1,083 service brake complaints for the make that year.

These are counts, not rates. Ford sells a lot of vehicles, so it will tend to have more complaints. The complaints are also unverified owner reports.
results.sql: select make, sum(crash_complaints) as crash_complaints, sum(complaints) as service_brake_complaints from fct_complaints_monthly where component_group='SERVICE BRAKES' and year(month)=2023 group by make order by 2 desc limit 1

results.question: Which car has the highest complaint rate per vehicle sold?
results.answer:
I can't answer this one, because the data has no sales figures. NHTSA publishes complaint counts, not the number of vehicles sold, so a complaint rate per vehicle sold can't be calculated from these tables. Complaint totals also tend to be higher for best-selling models, since there are more of them on the road.

I can rank vehicles by severe_share instead. That's the share of a vehicle's complaints that report a crash, fire, injury or death. It doesn't depend on sales volume. I would only include vehicles with at least 30 complaints. Complaints are unverified owner reports. Do you want me to run that?

results.question: What is the average price of a 2022 Toyota Camry?
results.answer:
I can't answer that because the data has no prices. It covers NHTSA vehicle safety complaints and recalls only, with no sales or pricing figures.

I can look up complaints, severity, or recalls for the 2022 Toyota Camry if you'd like.

results.question: In 2023, how many complaints in the electrical system component group reported a fire?
results.answer: In 2023, 405 complaints in the electrical system group reported a fire. That is out of 10,919 electrical system complaints received that year. I counted by the month NHTSA received each complaint, not by model year. These are unverified owner reports.
results.sql: SELECT SUM(fire_complaints) AS fire_complaints, SUM(complaints) AS electrical_complaints FROM fct_complaints_monthly WHERE component_group='ELECTRICAL SYSTEM' AND month >= '2023-01-01' AND month < '2024-01-01'

results.question: Which vehicle has the most complaints per owner in Australia?
results.answer:
I can't answer that with these tables. They only hold US NHTSA complaints and recalls, so they have nothing on Australia. They also have no sales or ownership figures, so I can't work out complaints per owner for any country.

For US vehicles, I can rank by severe_share, the share of complaints that report a crash, fire, injury or death. This is the fairest comparison available, and I would limit it to vehicles with at least 30 complaints. I can also show raw complaint counts, but those mostly reflect how many of each vehicle are on the road.
